description: Machine-readable list of every Truminds JSON Schema, for tsl and the insights service to load. Paths are relative to this file.
compatibility: Readers accept version N and N-1 of each schema (Doc 5 R-09); writers emit N only.

schemas.name: tsl-config
schemas.title: tsl.yaml (tsl-config.v1)
schemas.description: Per-companion-repo configuration: system codes, product repos, context and change limits, gates, PR and harness settings. Values may only tighten org defaults (E-CFG-01).

schemas.name: user-config
schemas.title: ~/.truminds/config.toml (user-config.v1)
schemas.description: Per-user tsl settings, stored as TOML and validated as the equivalent JSON object. Holds no identity provider or service endpoint values (those ship inside the wheel).

schemas.name: tsl-output
schemas.title: tsl --json output envelope (tsl-output.v1)
schemas.description: The one JSON object every tsl command (except tsl hook) prints on stdout with --json. Skills read only ok, code, exit, next and data.action.

schemas.name: session-index
schemas.title: Session index (session-index.v1)
schemas.description: ~/.truminds/sessions/<session_id>.json: binds a Claude Code session to the run it holds, so the pre-tool hook has a fast path when no run is bound.

schemas.name: tsl-local
schemas.title: .tsl/local.yaml (tsl-local.v1)
schemas.description: Laptop-local, git-ignored map from product repo short name to its clone path. Written by tsl init and tsl doctor.

schemas.name: skill-metadata
schemas.title: skill.yaml (skill-metadata.v1)
schemas.description: Truminds manifest of one SDLC skill: identity, version, status, owner, inputs, outputs, limits, rubric, checks, evals and permitted tools.

schemas.name: rubric
schemas.title: rubric.md front matter (rubric.v1)
schemas.description: Machine-read front matter of a skill's rubric: weighted criteria the reviewer scores 1-5 (signal S3) and severity triggers. Weights must sum to 1.00 (SKL-V07, checked by tsl validate).

schemas.name: skill-checks
schemas.title: checks.yaml (skill-checks.v1)
schemas.description: Code checks a skill's artifact must pass, selected from the tsl check library with parameters. Accepts the SDD-01 §9 library form (uses) and the SDD-03 §5.3 kind form.

schemas.name: eval-set
schemas.title: evals/eval-set.yaml (eval-set.v1)
schemas.description: Header of a skill's eval set: minimum case count and pass rate, and the invented system the fixtures describe.

schemas.name: eval-case
schemas.title: evals/cases/<id>/case.yaml (eval-case.v1)
schemas.description: One eval case: invented input fixtures and code-checked expectations (outcome set, gate results, JMESPath assertions). provenance and attestation are required by SDD-11 GR-6.

schemas.name: eval-expect
schemas.title: expect.yaml sketch (eval-expect.v1)
schemas.description: TST-01 sketch of case expectations: outcome set, band floor, gates that must pass, citations that must appear and invented elements that must not be claimed. SDD-01 owns the final format.

schemas.name: eval-result
schemas.title: Signed eval result (eval-result.v1)
schemas.description: skills/<skill>/evals/results/<version>.eval-result.json: signed by the skill author's key; binds case results and pass rate to an exact skill version and content hash.

schemas.name: ticket-snapshot
schemas.title: ticket.md front matter (ticket-snapshot.v1)
schemas.description: Read-only snapshot of the run's ticket, written by the run loop before the first step and hashed like any artifact so H6 staleness works on it. Field list is provisional until SDD-02 settles who writes it (SDD-01 O-07).

schemas.name: envelope
schemas.title: Artifact envelope (envelope.v1)
schemas.description: Common YAML front matter of every artifact <step>.md: identity of the attempt, input hashes, pack SHAs, claims with citations, trace and Known/Assumed/Unknown lists, plus the additive questions, resolves and code blocks (SDD-02 §12). Body schemas add their own keys.

schemas.name: intent
schemas.title: intent.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of requirement-review: numbered requirements with Known/Assumed/Unknown status, unknowns, questions and glossary checks (SDD-01 §13.2).

schemas.name: stories
schemas.title: stories.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of story-split: user stories traced to REQ ids with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: impact
schemas.title: impact.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of impact-analysis: modules, APIs and tables the change touches, each looked up in the generated facts. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: design
schemas.title: design.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of design: components on existing modules and endpoints marked new, changed or existing. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: threat-model
schemas.title: threat-model.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of threat-model: STRIDE rows per design component. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: change
schemas.title: change.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of implement: summary of the code change; code[] binds the artifact to the run branch diff. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: ut-result
schemas.title: ut-result.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of unit-test: tests run and coverage compared with the base. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: secure-review
schemas.title: secure-review.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of secure-code-review: SAST and secrets scan results referenced by hash, and findings. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: test-plan
schemas.title: test-plan.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of test-plan: tests that cover every acceptance criterion. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: test-result
schemas.title: test-result.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of test-automation: results linked to acceptance criteria. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: triage
schemas.title: triage.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of defect-triage: candidate components with likelihood and citations. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: plan
schemas.title: plan.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Generic plan artifact listed in registry §6; no skill in the Release-1 catalogue produces it yet. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: pipeline-review
schemas.title: pipeline-review.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of pipeline-review: findings that cite CI jobs and steps. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: deploy-failure
schemas.title: deploy-failure.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of deployment-failure-analysis: probable cause and findings citing stored log lines. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: ux-flow
schemas.title: ux-flow.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of ux-flow-review: findings that cite design-tool node ids (node: anchors). Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: a11y
schemas.title: a11y.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of accessibility-review: findings mapped to WCAG 2.1 AA success criteria. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: estimate
schemas.title: estimate.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of estimate-review: a size per story with cited evidence, else UNSIZED. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: status
schemas.title: status.v1 artifact front matter
schemas.description: Output of status-report: run counts per status that must equal the state.json files. Structured keys beyond the envelope are provisional until SDD-01 §12 fixes them.

schemas.name: workflow
schemas.title: Workflow definition (workflow.v1)
schemas.description: <id>.workflow.yaml in plugins/truminds/workflows/: ordered skill, gate and PR steps with input bindings. Graph rules (ids, cycles, reachability, bindings) are checked by tsl validate (E-WFL-02..05).

schemas.name: workflow-lock
schemas.title: Workflow lock file (workflow-lock.v1)
schemas.description: <id>.lock.json written by tsl validate --lock at release: each skill range of the workflow resolved to the exact version present in the plugin. Field list is provisional (SDD-02 names the file but not its fields).

schemas.name: run-state
schemas.title: runs/<run_id>/state.json (run-state.v1)
schemas.description: The run's state: status, pins, pack status, steps with every attempt, gates, questions and PRs. Written only by tsl with optimistic concurrency on rev.

schemas.name: run-lock
schemas.title: runs/active/<ticket>__<workflow>.lock (run-lock.v1)
schemas.description: The single lock file per ticket and workflow. Its fixed path makes a second laptop's git push fail (registry §10 row 9). Removed at COMPLETED or by tsl state unlock.

schemas.name: next-action
schemas.title: tsl next data payload (next-action.v1)
schemas.description: The data object of tsl next --json: one action for the run skill loop, with the step, attempt, pinned skill, artifact path, resolved inputs, feedback, answers, budget and progress.

schemas.name: feedback
schemas.title: runs/<run_id>/feedback/<step>.a<N>.json (feedback.v1)
schemas.description: Written by tsl decide on every RETRY and passed to attempt N+1: failed gates, verified findings, dropped finding ids and the ids the next artifact must resolve.

schemas.name: open-questions
schemas.title: runs/<run_id>/open-questions.md (open-questions.v1)
schemas.description: Front matter of open-questions.md plus the question blocks as tsl parses them. People fill only answer, answered_by and decision; tsl sets status.

schemas.name: approval-signature
schemas.title: Approval signature block (approval-signature.v1)
schemas.description: Signed block that tsl approve appends under a gate entry in approvals.md, between tsl:signature-begin and tsl:signature-end markers. Ed25519 over JCS of the block without signature.

schemas.name: approvals
schemas.title: runs/<run_id>/approvals.md (approvals.v1)
schemas.description: Front matter of approvals.md plus gate entries as tsl parses them; each signed entry carries an approval-signature.v1 block.

schemas.name: checks
schemas.title: <artifact>.checks.json (checks.v1)
schemas.description: Code-check record written by tsl verify: hard gates H1-H7 with codes, soft checks, input hashes, verifier evidence and product changes for code steps.

schemas.name: review-package
schemas.title: <artifact>.review-package.json (review-package.v1)
schemas.description: What tsl review prepare hands the reviewer: artifact, rubric, context sections and inputs by path, previous findings, and package_sha256 over the JCS form without that field. Field list is provisional.

schemas.name: review
schemas.title: <artifact>.review.json (review.v1)
schemas.description: Reviewer subagent output as stored by tsl review record: rubric scores, cited findings, claim verdicts and questions. Every citation is an object with ref and an 8-200 character quote.

schemas.name: verification
schemas.title: <artifact>.verification.json (verification.v1)
schemas.description: The signed check record written by tsl decide: hashes of the artifact, checks and review, input chain, kept and dropped findings, signals S1-S6, band, outcome and caps. Ed25519 over JCS without signature.

schemas.name: tool-log
schemas.title: runs/<run_id>/tool-log.jsonl line (tool-log.v1)
schemas.description: One JSON line per Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, Bash or MCP call seen by the pre-tool and pre-mcp hooks. Append-only; H7 checks it. target never leaves the companion repo.

schemas.name: audit
schemas.title: audits/<run_id>/<step>.audit.json (audit.v1)
schemas.description: Signed calibration audit of a High-band outcome by a tech lead who is not the run owner: deserved or miss, with a reason code.

schemas.name: harness-case
schemas.title: harness-evals/cases/<id>/case.yaml (harness-case.v1)
schemas.description: Labels for one harness-accuracy case on the invented sample system: expected gate results, outcome, band, planted defects and fabricated citations.

schemas.name: verifier-profile
schemas.title: verifiers/<name>@<major>/profile.yaml (verifier-profile.v1)
schemas.description: Container verifier profile for H3: image pinned by digest and the prepare, build, test, lint, sast, secrets and optional coverage steps. Only prepare may use the network.

schemas.name: policy
schemas.title: policy.yaml (policy.v2)
schemas.description: Run-dependent rules read by the pre-tool and pre-mcp hooks: write scope, Bash patterns in a run and MCP read/write classification. The org file is complete; a system's policy.yaml may only add denies (structurally: it cannot carry allow or read_tools lists).

schemas.name: context-pack
schemas.title: context/manifest.json (context-pack.v1)
schemas.description: Pack index written by tsl context build: sources at exact commits, extractors, sections with hashes, anchors and token estimates, redaction counts and effective limits. No timestamps, so it is byte-stable.

schemas.name: context-section
schemas.title: Judgement section front matter (context-section.v1)
schemas.description: Front matter of each human-curated context/*.md section. Only a human sets status reviewed; tsl context sign requires reviewed.

schemas.name: context-facts
schemas.title: context/generated/*.json (context-facts.v1)
schemas.description: Common envelope of every generated fact file. Fact ids are stable strings built from the fact itself (SDD-06 §3.4); fact fields beyond id, kind and source vary per extractor.

schemas.name: pack-signature
schemas.title: context/pack.signature.json (pack-signature.v1)
schemas.description: Tech lead's Ed25519 signature over the manifest hash and source commits (tsl context sign). signed_at is for key validity and audit only; freshness never uses it.

schemas.name: pod
schemas.title: pods/<id>/pod.yaml (pod.v1)
schemas.description: Pod definition: agents built from roles and skills, workflows, people and gates, business view and machine-checkable fit requirements.

schemas.name: improvement
schemas.title: evals/improvements/<imp_id>.json (improvement.v1)
schemas.description: Evidence file written by tsl improve check: the flags addressed, the new failing-first cases, before and after signed eval results, and regressions. signature here is the failure signature string, not a crypto signature.

schemas.name: consent-record
schemas.title: Client consent record (consent-record.v1)
schemas.description: Fields the insights service keeps about a signed client consent (codes only; the signed document lives in the contract store). Enforced by tsl init, context build and state start (E-CONS-01).

schemas.name: secrets
schemas.title: harness/rules/secrets.v1.yaml (secrets.v1)
schemas.description: H4a secret detector rule set shipped in tsl: detect-secrets plugins with limits plus Truminds regex rules (SEC-01 §7.2). Hits report the rule id and line only, never the value.

schemas.name: pii
schemas.title: harness/rules/pii.v1.yaml (pii.v1)
schemas.description: H4b personal-data detector rule set shipped in tsl (SEC-01 §7.3): regex plus checksum validators, reserved ignores and context words. Hits report the rule id and line only.

schemas.name: injection-markers
schemas.title: policy/injection-markers.yaml (injection-markers.v1)
schemas.description: Case-insensitive phrase list for the SC-INJ-01 soft check. A match lowers S2 and is listed in the PR body; it never blocks a run on its own.

schemas.name: event-envelope
schemas.title: Telemetry event envelope (event-envelope.v1)
schemas.description: One event inside a POST /v1/events batch. The body is validated separately against schemas/events/<type>.v<schema_version>.json. No user field: the server sets the user from the token.

schemas.name: session.started
schemas.title: Event body: session.started (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by the session-start hook. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: session.ended
schemas.title: Event body: session.ended (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by the session-end hook. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: run.started
schemas.title: Event body: run.started (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl state start. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: run.status_changed
schemas.title: Event body: run.status_changed (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl state, decide and pr. reason_code values follow SDD-02 §12, or an error code. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: step.started
schemas.title: Event body: step.started (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl next when it opens an attempt. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: step.decided
schemas.title: Event body: step.decided (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl decide. Carries ids, counts and codes only; no findings text. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: step.invalidated
schemas.title: Event body: step.invalidated (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl next when a step goes STALE (SDD-02 §10.2). Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: question.created
schemas.title: Event body: question.created (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl decide per question. No question text (RD-3 default). Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: question.answered
schemas.title: Event body: question.answered (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl state resume per answered question. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: approval.recorded
schemas.title: Event body: approval.recorded (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl approve. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: hook.decision
schemas.title: Event body: hook.decision (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by every hook invocation. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: pr.opened
schemas.title: Event body: pr.opened (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl pr per product repo. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: ci.verified
schemas.title: Event body: ci.verified (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl ci-verify with the CI ingest token (the only type that token may send). Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: context.signed
schemas.title: Event body: context.signed (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl context sign. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: context.drift
schemas.title: Event body: context.drift (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl context build --check. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: eval.recorded
schemas.title: Event body: eval.recorded (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl eval run. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: security.abort
schemas.title: Event body: security.abort (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl decide or a hook when a run aborts on E-SEC or E-POL. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: audit.recorded
schemas.title: Event body: audit.recorded (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent after a calibration audit (SDD-03 §16.3); run_id is in the envelope. Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: companion.lifecycle
schemas.title: Event body: companion.lifecycle (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl init and tsl companion archive (SDD-12 §9). Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: companion.policy_violation
schemas.title: Event body: companion.policy_violation (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by companion CI (tsl companion check). Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).

schemas.name: improvement.proposed
schemas.title: Event body: improvement.proposed (schema_version 1)
schemas.description: Sent by tsl improve pr (SDD-11 §10). Closed object; every string is length-capped (TM-08).
